detail: Records one more measured elimination for Linux Qt Quick. kclock 464252, the timer add-a-minute defect, was the most promising remaining pair because its observable is a duration that moves by a whole minute. Its affected revision 1a02e4d is Qt5-era and does not configure against a Qt6 image at all, so it cannot be built alongside the Qt6 subjects. That is now recorded next to the other eliminations, together with the separate fact that a current-master kclock timer defect would need kclockd running because TimerModel reaches the daemon over D-Bus rather than a config file. No runtime product behavior changes.
